body:
Founder ask: port DEADWEIGHT's display-name validation logic to TS via PARENA. Wrote stdlib/deadweight/account_rules.prn (is-valid-display-name, mirrors IDUNA's cleanDisplayName), verified for the C target: builds clean combined with stdlib/string.prn, compiles under DEADWEIGHT's -Wall -Wextra -Werror, ASan/UBSan-clean 8-assertion harness. Real, structural gap found attempting the TS target: emit_ts.c hard-rejects ANY region-annotated String param, which string.prn's own length/char-at both use -- confirmed even string.prn ALONE fails 'parena build ... -o *.ts'. This means no TypeScript build can use PARENA's real string-handling stdlib at all today. emit_ts_defn's own doc comment says region annotations should be a no-op for a GC'd target, but the code hard-errors instead -- a real, scoped fix (resolve the Type node, ignore @ Region) named in EMILY/BACKLOG.md SECTION 544 for whoever picks it up. PARENA 38cc82b.

⚓ ☃
title: New account_rules.prn + a real, previously-undiscovered TS-emitter gap found (string.prn can't be emitted to TS at all)
